stdin_protocol: Frozen private fixture harness supplied through stdin; do not mount host paths. Freeze exact harness and public Foundation asset input SHA before execution. Native actions remain forbidden until Root review.

natural_home.source: Base image node user natural home; private empty tmpfs, not copied/bound/reassigned from host. No HOME/CODEX_HOME override.

private_git.network_transport: local file only; all other Git protocols disabled in private configuration and OS network none

write_guard.implementation: Node hook using real /usr/bin/git, exact paths and structured JSONL audit. No second workflow/controller.
write_guard.allow_only: An update of refs/heads/master whose sole changed path is regular file members/teamai-fixture.yaml; YAML shape limited to fixture username/displayName/registeredAt. The initial public seed is created locally before installing this hook.
deny: deletion/new unexpected ref/symlink/oversize or malformed member content
write_guard.reporting_policy: No usage/session/knowledge automatic reports. Start with zero fixture history. Every attempted non-member push is rejected and makes the experiment fail even if TeamAI catches it or exits0. Do not retry or remove the guard.
audit: UTC + old/new/ref + exact changed path set + accepted/rejected reason
real git argv/cwd/exit via /work/bin/git wrapper delegating only to /usr/bin/git
no credential values; only dummy fixture identity exists
write_guard.calibration: Before native commands, prove a synthetic non-member stats update is rejected and bare HEAD is unchanged. Test namespaces and branches are disposable only.

distribution_boundary.unique_source: Existing Foundation exporter and fixed method/profile manifest; no vendored body modification.
distribution_boundary.native_output: TeamAI staged tool paths only under /work/consumer/.teamai/distribution-staging; built-in codewiki/report/hooks cannot enter accepted profile discovery.
distribution_boundary.consumer: Existing adapter plus FoundationLock exact complete-file/digest allowlist; source acceptance is not inferred from CLI exit0.
distribution_boundary.fresh_home_options: No user inheritance; explicit sharing.recall.enabled=false, env.injectShellProfile=false, coauthor disabled, hook/MCP autoApply=false, built-in hooks disabled; verify actual assembly, not config-only counts.
distribution_boundary.next_authoring: Prepare minimal native-format release view and fixture harness in original P1_2 owns. Preserve real RED/GREEN for init/pull/update/repeat/order/user entries/retirement/uninstall/cold discovery. No host model turn or global state access.

network_attempts: Any native outside-network attempt must remain denied by OS namespace, retain actual stderr/exit evidence and stop for Root. Do not switch sources/providers or add permissions.
not_authorized_by_this_plan: host HOME/config/secret/socket or live repository mounts

root_approved_single_delta.change: /work tmpfs explicitly exec only; home/tmp remain noexec; all other options unchanged
root_approved_single_delta.basis: actual mode755/X_OK EACCES and mount noexec; Root explicit subsequent authorization

root_approved_python_image_only_delta.scope: CCadapter fixture only; not Comet/I02 Python>=3.12
